title: Sources tell senators of recovered and reverse-engineered craft

tellings.quote: Um yes. Uh uh these are people who uh found their way one way or another to us on Capitol Hill and met with uh with senators and who made precisely those kinds of claims.

plain: Between 2017 and 2024, people came to Capitol Hill and told senators that the government had recovered craft not made by humans and taken them apart to learn how they work. Kurt McConnell, a staffer for the US Senate, says he was there, and that these people "met with senators" and "made precisely those kinds of claims." If true, it would mean such programs exist and were reported to Congress.
